# What each place offers

Read one section, `sed -n '/^## Tabs/,/^## /p'` on this file; the sections are Sidebar, Tabs, A website's tab, Bookmarks bar, A chat, Chats page, Files, Apps, Command menu. `;` parts a menu's groups, `› [ ]` is a submenu, keys are the Mac's, then Windows and Linux's, and `<words>` stand for the user's own. An item that does not apply to what is up is left out of the menu or turned off. Places not here have more.

## Sidebar

- Top to bottom: Search (⌘K / Ctrl+K), Projects, New project, <project>, Actions for <project>, New (⌘N / Ctrl+N), Settings, Notifications, History, Help
- Right-click a tab group: Open in New Window, Duplicate Tab Group; Pin; Close Tab Group, Close Other Tab Groups, Close Tab Groups Above, Close Tab Groups Below
- Right-click the empty space: New Tab Group (⌘N / Ctrl+N), Reopen Closed Tab (⇧⌘T / Ctrl+Shift+T); New Window (⇧⌘N / Ctrl+Shift+N), Merge All Windows
- Right-click a project, or its ⋯: View project details
- Right-click the Projects heading: New Project…
- History button: <tab groups closed lately>; Show All History
- Help button: Send feedback…, Support; Keyboard shortcuts (?)

## Tabs

- A side's row of tabs: Close <page>, New tab
- Right-click any tab: Open in Split, Move to Other Side, New Tab in Split (⌥⌘N / Alt+Shift+N), Join Sides, Move to New Tab Group, Move to Another Window › [New Window; <window>], Move to New Window; Duplicate; Close (⌘W / Ctrl+W), Close Other Tabs, Close Tabs to the Left, Close Tabs to the Right, Close Split (⌥⌘W / Alt+Shift+W)
- A website's tab also has: Add to Bookmarks, Reload (⌘R / Ctrl+R), Copy URL
- Right-click the row's empty space: New Tab (⌘T / Ctrl+T), Reopen Closed Tab (⇧⌘T / Ctrl+Shift+T); New Tab in Split (⌥⌘N / Alt+Shift+N), Join Sides, Close Split (⌥⌘W / Alt+Shift+W); New Window (⇧⌘N / Ctrl+Shift+N), Merge All Windows
- Right-click the New tab button: <tabs and groups closed lately>; Show All History
- Right-click a link in the app's own pages: Open in Default Browser, Open in Split, Open in New Tab, Open in New Tab Group, Open in New Window, Add to Bookmarks, Copy Link

## A website's tab

- More actions, the ⋮ at the toolbar's right end: History › [<recent pages>; Show All History], Bookmarks › [Bookmark this tab… (⌘D / Ctrl+D), Bookmark all tabs… (⇧⌘D / Ctrl+Shift+D), Show bookmarks bar (⇧⌘B / Ctrl+Shift+B), Bookmark manager (⌥⌘B / Ctrl+Shift+O)], Clear browsing data…; Zoom out, 100% › [50%, 75%, 100%, 125%, 150%, 200%, 300%, 400%], Zoom in; Print… (⌘P / Ctrl+P), Find in page (⌘F / Ctrl+F), Save page as…, Copy URL, Share… (Mac only), Open in <default browser>; Extensions › [Manage extensions, Chrome Web Store]; View as › [Actual size; Mobile (390×844), Tablet (820×1180), Desktop (1440×900)], Hard reload, Block ads, Developer tools
- Downloads, in the toolbar once something was downloaded: Downloads, Clear, Show in File Manager (Linux only), Show in File Explorer (Windows only), Show in Finder (Mac only), Remove from list

## Bookmarks bar

- Left to right: Apps, Open an app, Chats, Open a recent chat, Files, Open Files at a place, <folder>, <bookmark>
- Right-click the bar: New Folder…, Manage Bookmarks…; Show Bookmarks Bar
- Right-click a bookmark: Open, Open in Split, Open in New Tab, Open in New Tab Group, Open in New Window; Edit…, Copy Address, Move To › [<folder>, All Bookmarks]; Delete; New Folder…, Manage Bookmarks…; Show Bookmarks Bar
- Right-click a folder: Open All, Open All in New Window; Rename, Delete; New Folder…, Manage Bookmarks…; Show Bookmarks Bar

## A chat

- Its top: Open <project>, Change project, <chat>, Chat menu
- Its menu, on the caret after the title or a right-click on its tab: Stop; Mark as Unread, Star; Rename, Project › [No project, <project>, New project…]; Export as Markdown…, Copy › [Work Folder Path; For an Agent]; Send Feedback…; Archive; Delete Chat…
- On a message of yours, pointing at it: Edit message, Copy message
- Under a reply: Branch from here
- Reply box: Add to this prompt, Model, Dictate, Send; Stop while it works
- Reply box's +: Browser, <this computer>; Attach files, Add a folder; Apps, Skills

## Chats page

- Top of the page: Search, View options, Inbox, Drafts, Archived
- View options, at the search's right: Three lines (Title, preview, project and files), Two lines (Title, then project or last reply), One line (Just the titles), Group by day
- On a chat, pointing at it: Project, Archive, Mark as Unread, Star
- Right-click a chat: Open, Open in New Tab, Open in New Window; Mark as Unread, Star; Rename, Project › [No project, <project>, New project…]; Export as Markdown…, Copy › [Work Folder Path; For an Agent]; Send Feedback…; Archive; Delete Chat…

## Files

- Right-click a file: Open (⌘O / Enter), Open in Split, Open in New Tab, Open in New Tab Group, Open in New Window, Move to Recycle Bin (Del, Windows only), Open in (Mac only) › [<apps that open it>]; Move to Trash (⌘⌫ / Del, Mac and Linux only); Rename (↩ / F2), Cut (Ctrl+X, Windows and Linux only), Copy (⌘C / Ctrl+C), Duplicate (⌘D), Preview (Space), Properties (Alt+Enter, Windows and Linux only), Info (⌘I, Mac only); Add to Bookmarks, Copy Path (⌥⌘C / Ctrl+Shift+C), Show in File Manager (Linux only), Show in File Explorer (Windows only)
- A folder also has: Add to Favorites
- Right-click the empty space: New Folder (⇧⌘N / Ctrl+Shift+N); Paste into “<folder>” (⌘V / Ctrl+V), Move into “<folder>” (⌥⌘V, Mac only)
- Right-click a place in the sidebar or the address: Open in New Tab, Open in New Window, Show in File Manager (Linux only), Show in File Explorer (Windows only), Open in (Mac only) › [<apps that open it>]; Copy, Copy Path; Remove from Favorites
- Right-click a file in a chat: Open in (Mac only) › [<apps that open it>]; Copy, Save as…, Show in File Manager (Linux only), Show in File Explorer (Windows only); Show in Finder (Mac only)

## Apps

- Right-click an app's tile: See what Instrument can do, Check connection; Name account…, Connect another account; Disconnect, Remove
- ⋯ by the app's name on its page: See what Instrument can do, Check connection; Remove
- ⋯ on an account's row: Name account…; Disconnect, Remove

## Command menu

- Commands: Check for updates, Clear browsing data, Keyboard shortcuts, Merge all windows, New tab, New tab group, New window, Send feedback, Use dark theme, Use light theme
